title: WPMS/837/2015 of Mahila Maha Vidyalaya p.g. College Vs Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University Srinagar AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
Civil Misc. Writ Petition No. 837 of 2015
(Under Article 226 of the Constitution of India)
Mahila Maha Vidyalaya (P.G.) College ............. Petitioner

versus
Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna University and another
 .......... Respondents

Mr. Arvind Vashishth, Senior Advocate, assisted by Mr. Munish Bharadwaj,
Advocate, present for the writ petitioner.
Mr. Paresh Tripathi, Advocate, present for the respondents/University.
U.C. Dhyani, J. (Oral)
1. By means of present writ petition under Article 226 of the
Constitution of India, the writ petitioner seeks to:
(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus
commanding the respondents to treat the affiliation of the
course affiliated with/recognized by respondent's
University to the petitioner institution during preceding
years as permanent affiliation in terms of statues of the
respondent University.
(ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus
directing the respondents not to compel the petitioner to
seek affiliation of the courses affiliated /by respondent's
University each year.
(iii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus
that so called non-permanent departments who are non-

2
aided by the Government also, are not discriminated on
account of their legal status and the students are not
charged twice or thrice fee for examination only because
the respective departments or colleges are deprived of the
legal equality with aided or so called permanent ones.
2. The main facts giving rise to the present writ petition are
that in the year 1995, the petitioner was granted affiliation
by Chaudhary Charan Singh University for conducting
Post Graduate Course in Political Science. This affiliation
was granted temporarily. For the last 20 years, this
affiliation is being granted to the petitioner institution on
year to year basis. The petitioner institution provides
research facilities as per U.G.C. norms. Political Science is
a recognized research centre. On 9th October, 1996, the
petitioner institution was granted affiliation for conducting
Bachelor degree course in subject Home Science with
effect from 1st July, 1996 for a period of three years.
3. The affiliation so granted was extended by Chaudhary
Charan Singh University from time to time and after
formation of State of Uttarakhand, by the respondent
University from time to time on temporary basis. In the
year 2000, the petitioner institution was granted
recognition and affiliation for conducting Master Degree
course in Home Science. Since the year 1967, the
petitioner institution had permanent affiliation for
conducting three years Bachelor Degree Course in Hindi,
English, Sanskrit, Political Science, Economics and
Music. That status continued by respondent University.

3

6. No Counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the
respondents despite having being given repeated
opportunities for the same, hence the facts given in the
Writ Petition are treated to be correct.
7. A bunch of Writ Petitions being Writ Petition (M/S) Nos.
2550 of 2014, 2551 of 2014, 2552 of 2014, 2583 of 2014,
2582 of 2014 and 2589 of 2014 were decided by the
Coordinate Bench of this Court vide judgment and order
dated 04.12.2014, as follows:
 "In the result, all the writ petitions are allowed.
Central University is directed to process the
applications of the students pursuing their studies in
different paramedical courses, which were duly
affiliated by the State University prior to creation of
the Central University and to hold their examinations
and to permit the students to appear in the
examinations to be held from 05.12.2014 and to
declare their results.
 No order as to costs."

5
8. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the respondent-University that Special Appeals have been filed by the
respondents no.2 & 3 against the judgment and order dated
04.12.2014 before Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court.
It is also submitted that the Special Appeals have although
been admitted, but no interim order has been passed in
these Special Appeals.
9. Since issues arising out of the present writ petition are
identical to the Writ Petitions (M/S) Nos. 2550 of 2014,
2551 of 2014, 2552 of 2014, 2583 of 2014, 2582 of 2014
and 2589 of 2014 decided by the Coordinate Bench of this
Court vide judgment and order dated 04.12.2014,
therefore, the present Writ Petition is disposed of in the
light of the judgment rendered in the aforesaid Writ
Petitions as follows:
 In the result, the writ petition is allowed.
Central University is directed to process the
applications of the students pursuing their studies in
different courses, which were duly affiliated by the
State University prior to creation of the Central
University, to hold their examinations and to permit
the students to appear in such examinations as and
when due.
 No order as to costs.
 (U.C. Dhyani, J.)
 23.06.2015
Kaushal
